# Gauge (`gauge`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.js from schema.json. Edit the schema, then run `npm run docs`. -->

One headline number measured against a floor, ceiling, or goal, with a bar showing where it sits and whether it passes.

**Use when:** A single metric judged against a threshold or target: margin vs a policy floor, GP attainment vs quota, fill rate vs target, days to ship vs a maximum.

**Don't use when:** There is no threshold or target (use kpi), several values need comparing (use bar_chart), or the metric's history matters more than where it stands now (use line_chart with a reference line).

**Sizes:** S (default), M

## Fields

Fields from `id` to `note` are shared by every widget.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"gauge"` | yes | Always "gauge". |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique id within the dashboard: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, e.g. "open-ar". |
| `title` | string | yes | What the widget shows, in sentence case with no trailing period, e.g. "Revenue by rep, Q3 2026". |
| `subtitle` | string |  | Optional one line of context under the title: scope, filter, or unit. |
| `size` | `"S"` \| `"M"` |  | Width on the 12-column grid (S = 3, M = 6, L = 9, full = 12). Allowed: S, M. Default: `"S"`. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional footnote: caveats, definitions, or why data is missing. |
| `value` | number or null | yes | The metric as a raw number. Use null when there is no data and explain why in note. |
| `format` | `"number"` \| `"integer"` \| `"currency"` \| `"percent"` |  | How value, target, and range are displayed. percent expects fractions: 0.15 shows as 15%. Default: `"number"`. |
| `target` | object | yes | The threshold the value is judged against. |
| `target.value` | number | yes | The threshold as a raw number in the same format as value, e.g. 0.08 for an 8% floor. |
| `target.kind` | `"floor"` \| `"ceiling"` \| `"goal"` | yes | floor: at or above is good, below fails (margin floor). ceiling: at or below is good, above fails (max days to ship). goal: progress toward a number; reaching it is good, falling short is shown as progress, not failure (quota). |
| `target.label` | string |  | Name of the threshold, e.g. "KPA policy floor" or "Q4 quota". Default: the kind ("floor", "ceiling", "goal"). |
| `target.warning_within` | number |  | Floors and ceilings only: how close to the threshold, on the passing side, counts as a warning, in the value's units. 0.02 with an 8% floor makes 8% to 10% amber. |
| `range` | object |  | Optional scale for the bar. Default: 0 to a round number above the value and target. |
| `range.min` | number | yes | Left end of the bar. |
| `range.max` | number | yes | Right end of the bar. |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "gauge",
  "id": "margin-vs-floor",
  "title": "Gross margin, Q3 2026",
  "subtitle": "Commercial, all KPAs",
  "size": "S",
  "format": "percent",
  "value": 0.152,
  "target": { "value": 0.08, "kind": "floor", "label": "KPA policy floor", "warning_within": 0.02 }
}
```

## Checks beyond the schema

- Warns when a percent value, target, or range looks like a whole number (45 instead of 0.45).
- Error when range.min is not below range.max.
- Warns when the value or target falls outside range (the bar is clipped).
- Warns when warning_within is set on a goal (it only applies to floors and ceilings).
